entities.name: Sigma
entities.description: A dwarf planet orbiting the Sothera supervoid in the Edge, with arid orange clay surface.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: Abandoned mining colony built to mine moxite.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Supervoid system around which Sigma orbits.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: Plane where the Sothera system lies.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: Artifact discovered by miners that changed history.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Group whose palestar sent warmakers to eradicate the colony.

entities.name: Hopelight warmakers
entities.description: Four warmakers dispatched to eradicate the inhabitants.

events.summary: Sigma's Reach is built and colonized between about 4554 and 4561 AR.
events.quote: Sigma's Reach was built between about 4554 and 4561 AR and colonized by workers.

events.summary: By 4564 the miners discover the Endstone and place it in quality assurance.
events.quote: By 4564, the miners discovered the Endstone

events.summary: A Sunstar Free Company palestar sends four Hopelight warmakers to eradicate the inhabitants.
events.quote: dispatched four Hopelight warmakers to eradicate the inhabitants

events.summary: The Endstone changes history so no one ever arrived to work, and the palestar passes by unharmed.
events.quote: the Endstone changed history so that no one ever arrived to start work

relations.quote: Its only settlement is the abandoned mining colony Sigma's Reach .
